label: The ordinary-comparative gap attacks more such on its MORE_3 reading
note: Target: 'more such' d5a94eb1 read with the ordinary comparative MORE_3 (the reading of its own example, 'the cause of another's heat is hotter'). Mechanism: induction transfers energy electromagnetically, so the cause of the workpiece's heat need not be hotter than it. Independent justification: standard induction-heating practice (water-cooled coil below about 60 °C, workpiece at roughly 800-1200 °C). Relevance: d5a94eb1 is a proved leaf on God-existence routes. Scope: an established case against the MORE_3 reading only; it does not touch the MORE_4 reading, the esse instance cffad050 (the coil causes no being) or Metaphysics II.1's synonymous premise (the coil is no synonymous cause of heat). The consumer audit in the note finds that the God-existence and stage-two consumers apply d5a94eb1 only at esse.
